WITH AccountStats AS ( SELECT CUR_SEQ, COUNT(*) AS total_enrolled, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE STATUS = 'ENROLLED') AS active_accounts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE STATUS = 'DROPOUT') AS dropout_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE STATUS = 'EARLYOUT') AS earlyout_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE STATUS = 'GRADUATED') AS graduated_count FROM lms.TB_ACCOUNT GROUP BY CUR_SEQ ), TestStats AS ( /* 현재 재학중인 학생의 시험 제출 수만 집계 */ SELECT t.SUB_SEQ, COUNT(r.RESULT_SEQ) AS submitted_count FROM lms.TB_TEST t LEFT JOIN lms.TB_TEST_RESULT r ON t.TEST_SEQ = r.TEST_SEQ LEFT JOIN lms.TB_ACCOUNT acc ON r.account_seq = acc.account_seq WHERE (acc.STATUS = 'ENROLLED' OR r.RESULT_SEQ IS NULL) GROUP BY t.SUB_SEQ ) SELECT c.CUR_SEQ AS cur_seq, c.CUR_NAME AS cur_name, c.ROOM AS class_name, c.TERM AS term, c.START_DATE || ' ~ ' || c.END_DATE AS period, COALESCE(ast.total_enrolled, 0) AS total_enrolled, COALESCE(ast.active_accounts, 0) AS active_accounts, COALESCE(ast.dropout_count, 0) AS dropout_count, COALESCE(ast.earlyout_count, 0) AS earlyout_count, COALESCE(ast.graduated_count, 0) AS graduated_count, ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN COALESCE(ast.active_accounts, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COALESCE(tst.submitted_count, 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(ast.active_accounts, 0) * 100) END ), 1) AS total_avg_ratio,
JSONB_AGG( JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'subjectName', s.SUB_NAME, 'submittedCount', COALESCE(tst.submitted_count, 0), 'ratio', CASE WHEN COALESCE(ast.active_accounts, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(tst.submitted_count, 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(ast.active_accounts, 0) * 100, 1) END ) ORDER BY s.SUB_SEQ ) AS subjects FROM lms.TB_CURRICULUM c LEFT JOIN AccountStats ast ON c.CUR_SEQ = ast.CUR_SEQ JOIN lms.TB_SUBJECT s ON c.CUR_SEQ = s.CUR_SEQ LEFT JOIN TestStats tst ON s.SUB_SEQ = tst.SUB_SEQ
AND TO_CHAR(c.START_DATE, 'YYYY') = #{year}
GROUP BY c.CUR_SEQ, c.CUR_NAME, c.ROOM, c.TERM, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE, ast.total_enrolled, ast.active_accounts, ast.dropout_count, ast.earlyout_count, ast.graduated_count ORDER BY c.TERM DESC

WITH StudentBase AS ( SELECT account_seq, account_name FROM lms.tb_account WHERE cur_seq = #{curSeq} AND status = 'ENROLLED' ), SubjectBase AS ( SELECT sub_seq, sub_name FROM lms.tb_subject WHERE cur_seq = #{curSeq} ), ScoreMatrix AS ( SELECT sb.account_seq, sb.account_name, sj.sub_name, COALESCE(tr.total_score, 0) AS score FROM StudentBase sb CROSS JOIN SubjectBase sj LEFT JOIN lms.tb_test t ON sj.sub_seq = t.sub_seq LEFT JOIN lms.tb_test_result tr ON t.test_seq = tr.test_seq AND sb.account_seq = tr.account_seq ) SELECT account_seq, account_name, sub_name, score, SUM(score) OVER(PARTITION BY account_seq) AS total_sum, ROUND(AVG(score) OVER(PARTITION BY account_seq), 1) AS total_avg FROM ScoreMatrix ORDER BY account_name ASC, sub_name ASC
